issues.reason: s1_socialProof and hero both convey credibility signals; risk of redundancy without adding new proof in the hero.
issues.fix: Keep hero focused on credibility signals without repurposing the same elements already shown in s1; ensure s1 adds unique logos, quantified outcomes, and quotes.

issues.reason: s1_socialProof lacks quantified outcomes and quotes despite requirement to include them.
issues.fix: Add brief, specific quotes from customers and a quantified outcome (e.g., time-to-insight or decision speed improvements) to strengthen credibility.

issues.reason: Secondary CTA offers a Demo, which may dilute the primary free trial path if overemphasized.
issues.fix: If including a secondary CTA, ensure it is clearly lower-friction than the primary (e.g., “Request a Demo” only after initial trial intent is established) or consider removing secondary CTA to preserve trial focus.

issues.reason: Contains percentages (2x, 30%, 5x) which are explicitly restricted unless the brief states them.
issues.fix: Replace with qualitative outcomes or non-numeric impact statements (e.g., "speed of insights,") ensuring nothing contradicts the constraint.
